source_note: 采用完整前侧实拍核单体屋顶与三间正面；Commons南面近景核门窗和斗栱。未使用背面照片生成。移除遮挡的古树、撑杆、院墙、独立经幢与相邻建筑，台基简化为低基座。966年是文博资料通行定年，不声称存在966年梁架题记。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing: use only its elegant, very delicate, slightly organic thin black lines and restrained details, with generous white spaces. Do not copy its Buddha subject.
Image 2 is SUBJECT GEOMETRY: a real complete front-oblique photograph of WENSHU HALL 文殊殿, GEYUAN TEMPLE 阁院寺, Laiyuan, Hebei, a Liao-dynasty building conventionally dated 966. Use this actual building, NOT the gatehouse or rear library. Image 3 is a closer photograph of the SAME SOUTH FRONT FACADE: use its detailed front door-and-window layout and brackets, but do not imitate its close crop. Both are actual photo references.
Draw a centered straight-on front architectural view. Preserve the actual THREE wide front structural bays separated by FOUR robust vertical posts, NOT five bays. The facade is enclosed by tall wooden lattice door/window panels with small patterned TRANSOM panels in a horizontal row above them and solid rectangular lower panels. At the center is the entrance, with matching panel arrangements either side as seen. Render the windows as fine sparse lattice outlines on white, without filling the interiors black. Keep the broad shallow SINGLE-EAVE HIP-AND-GABLE roof and the simple long low ridge, roof mostly blank white. Preserve the unusually deep eaves, broad simple multi-arm column-top brackets, one smaller intermediate bracket per bay, and the modest shallow base. The post tops and bracket forms must follow these actual photo references, not generic ornate Qing temple decoration. No second roof, no extra porch, no statues or invented finials. Do not enlarge absent ridge-end sculptures. Remove the hanging sign entirely and all lettering.
Complete roof, corners, wall base and building inside the canvas. Remove the two trees, poles and braces, detached stone columns, low courtyard enclosing wall in the foreground, modern signs, neighbouring roofs, plants and all people. Show only the hall and its plain low rectangular plinth with a few short ground lines. Do not invent a grand stairway or large terrace. Keep verticals upright, undo camera perspective gently without changing actual proportions.
Refined sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE: confident very fine contours, with even finer selective internal lines. All surfaces stay white. No thick contours, no solid dark fills, shadows, grey wash, hatching, crosshatching, engraving density, pencil grain, weathering texture, gradients, color, or gold. Suggest lattice patterns with open, airy linework rather than reproducing every small carving. Roof has only 10-14 widely spaced slope contours, no dense tile grid. No text, calligraphy, watermark, caption, border or frame.
Landscape 1536 x 1024. Complete hall occupies about 82 percent of width, centered with generous balanced margins on all sides. Match the style master line weight and calm visual density.

historical_sources.publisher: 河北旅游资讯网（保定市文化广电和旅游局）
historical_sources.supports: 清华测绘据形制定文殊殿966；三间三间、内部两柱、四椽栿对乳栿、原有棂花格子门窗与1114铁钟。

historical_sources.publisher: 中国人民大学清史研究所实地考察
historical_sources.supports: 辽应历十六年966、单檐布瓦歇山、面阔进深各三间、减柱造、五铺作偷心造；现有元明修葺题记与部分辽代窗棂。
涞源县文物保管所采访：1996年第四批国保；文殊殿为辽代原构，其余建筑经明清重修或重建；面阔进深三间。
正文明确未见与创建年代直接相关的碑刻题记、由形制推断辽代；故将966作为通行定年而非现存梁架纪年。照片与细节核对。

site_recommendation.name: 涞源阁院寺
site_recommendation.era: 辽应历十六年（通行定年）
site_recommendation.place: 河北保定 · 涞源县城
site_recommendation.coordinate_note: 寺院近似位置，非单体测绘坐标。
site_recommendation.lede: 涞源县城里，阁院寺文殊殿以三间宽阔立面和低缓的歇山屋面保留着辽代木构的气度。檐下硕大斗栱与古老棂花窗相接，木构骨架之外，细小的门窗装修也延续着千年手艺。
facts: 文殊殿为辽代木构，文博资料通常定年于辽应历十六年（966）；元明曾有修葺。
面阔与进深各三间，单檐歇山；殿内采用减柱做法，仅用两根内柱。
阁院寺1996年列入第四批全国重点文物保护单位；文殊殿保存部分辽代棂花格子门窗。
